hypothesis: Recent moves in traditional markets -- US stocks (S&P 500, Nasdaq), the US dollar index, gold, oil and the 10-year Treasury yield -- carry DIRECTIONAL information about Bitcoin's forward returns, in the direction of co-movement for stocks (positive), negative for the dollar, ambiguous for gold/oil/yields. Expected signs stated in advance: stocks +, dollar -, others unspecified.
acceptance_criterion: PRE-REGISTERED before running. Direction: Spearman(feature, return_H) block-bootstrap 95% interval excludes zero with the same sign in BOTH exploration and validation. Magnitude: same, plus |rho| >= 0.10 both periods.

availability_check.source: Yahoo Finance chart API (free, no key), daily bars, 10+ years for ^GSPC, ^IXIC, DX-Y.NYB, GC=F, CL=F, ^TNX; exchange timezone reported per series. Values for indices are not revised; futures continuous contracts (GC=F, CL=F) are the front month as Yahoo serves it today (a minor reconstruction caveat, noted).
availability_check.point_in_time_rule: a daily bar for trading date D is treated as known from D 22:00 UTC -- after the NYSE close (20:00/21:00 UTC depending on daylight time) and after CME daily settlements. Conservative by 1-3 hours. Weekends/holidays keep the last known value (staleness is itself recorded as a feature).
availability_check.unavailable: intraday history for these series is not free beyond ~2 years; not used. Macro EVENT calendars (CPI, FOMC) with trustworthy release timestamps: not available free with history -> UNAVAILABLE.

feature_version: macro v1: for each of spx, ndq, dxy, gold, oil, tnx: <name>_ret_1d (last known close vs the one before) and <name>_ret_5d; plus macro_staleness_h (hours since the last known close)

target.definition: signed forward return (direction) and absolute forward return (magnitude)
target.outcome: close of candle opening at as_of+H

point_in_time: for reference hour t (cutoff t+1h), only bars with availability time <= cutoff; tested with a garbled-future test and an explicit 'bar for today is invisible before 22:00 UTC' test
notes: 13 features x 5 horizons = 65 direction tests; the both-periods rule is the guard. Bitcoin's correlation with stocks is known to have risen after 2020, so a validation-only effect is plausible and would be reported as inconsistent.
